'''Bash Fateau''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gem]] fisherman who fashioned a crew to find Corusca stones on [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. As a young man, he flew [[agriflitter]]s on [[Montitia]], but spent all his savings to become a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. He hoped that finding one or two gems would let him retire to a beach on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

Fateau would dare to perform any action that showed off his piloting skills.
